mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is today's balanced dish. It is a warm, clear day with a high of 89 degrees that feels like 90 near Badger Ridge Middle School. Tonight features a beautiful waxing crescent moon, and you can catch the International Space Station flying overhead starting at 9:30 PM for five minutes, rising in the northwest.

The City of Verona is highlighting several sustainability programs. Apartment residents are encouraged to use the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue for home composting. Additionally, the city is rolling out anti-idling technology on its new ambulance and replacing local streetlights with energy-efficient LEDs to reduce municipal emissions.

Mark your calendars for a fun weekend. There is live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Louie on July 17th. On July 18th, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market on the Square or head to the Mount Horeb Art Fair, followed by the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market coming up next Wednesday, July 22nd.

In local law enforcement news, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle crash on Friday, July 10th, at the intersection of Old PB and Whalen Road. A bicyclist sustained minor injuries, and a Verona driver was cited for failing to yield the right of way.

Since Culver's is currently closed and opens at 10:00 AM, plan ahead to grab today's delicious flavor of the day, Snickers Swirl, packed with candy pieces and caramel. If you miss it, tomorrow's mouthwatering flavor is Mint Cookie!
